Free · self-paced · from Namaste Bookshop

Learn tarot one layer at a time

Namaste Tarot Center is a study site for people who want to read tarot themselves. Start with how the deck is built, work through card notes and practice spreads, then sit for a reading at Namaste Bookshop and watch how a working reader puts it all together.

  1. 1

    Understand the deck

    78 cards, two arcana, four suits, sixteen court cards. Learn the skeleton first.

  2. 2

    Study the cards

    Notes for all 22 Major Arcana and a table for each suit, each with something to practice.

  3. 3

    Practice spreads

    Four layouts, from a single morning card to a five-card cross for a decision.

  4. 4

    Sit for a real reading

    What happens at the table, and what a student can notice from the other chair.

  5. 5

    Take the free course

    Namaste Bookshop's seven-lesson Online Tarot School walks you to your first full reading.

Is psychic ability required?

Not at all. Reading tarot is mostly looking closely, knowing the structure and practicing a lot. Intuition grows with use.

Which deck should I learn on?

Any deck you will actually pick up. If you want a guide, the study decks page compares seven common starter decks.

Namaste Tarot Center is a free study site run by Wealth Edge Ventures Inc. and connected to Namaste Bookshop, 2 West 14th Street, New York, NY 10011. Readings and decks are booked and sold through namastebookshop.com.
